title: Concept: crossdomain.xml permits every origin
description: The wildcard policy lets a malicious page read responses from this host through a legacy plugin bridge. Even where plugins are gone, the file confirms an allow-all posture that reviewers of the same estate should expect elsewhere.
applicability: Responses that serve a cross-domain policy file from the web root.
risk: A hostile page reads authenticated responses from this host through any client that still honours the policy.
